description: This file defines data structures and a class for managing inbox notifications on an Apple Watch app. It handles the storage, restoration, and display of notifications, including persisting state, processing incoming messages, and presenting local notifications with haptic feedback.

classes.name: WatchInboxStore
classes.description: A class responsible for managing the inbox notifications, including receiving messages, persisting state, and displaying local notifications on the Apple Watch.

methods.name: consume
methods.description: Processes an incoming notification message, updates the state, and triggers a local notification.

methods.name: restorePersistedState
methods.description: Restores saved state from user defaults.

methods.name: persistState
methods.description: Saves the current state into user defaults.

methods.name: deliveryKey
methods.description: Generates a unique key for a message based on its ID or content.

methods.name: ensureNotificationAuthorization
methods.description: Requests notification permissions if not already granted.

methods.name: mapHapticRisk
methods.description: Maps a risk level string to a haptic type for user feedback.

methods.name: makeReplyDraft
methods.description: Creates a draft reply based on a user action.

methods.name: markReplySending
methods.description: Updates state to indicate a reply is being sent.

methods.name: markReplyResult
methods.description: Updates state based on the result of a reply attempt.

methods.name: postLocalNotification
methods.description: Schedules and presents a local notification with optional risk-based haptic feedback.
